# Informed first-source experiment

Before implementation, Codex read the adopted constitutional records, the
original #22/#27 criteria, current Reference and the common/finite/selected
call paths. The ordinary implementation contract was published in
[#22](https://github.com/MGYamada/Qleisli/issues/22#issuecomment-6010609715).
Exact model/sampling settings are unavailable. This is informed development,
not the few-example authoring experiment required by #22 criterion 10.

Baseline: `6db68d05607556a893e9d65e66138b486313ad9a`.
Each first project is retained unchanged. Expected baseline: the common checker
rejects each ordinary Basis call before concrete eligibility. Desired behavior:
the finite shared flip returns `(1,0)`; noninjective ordinary AND returns 0;
nested Unit/Bit labels return 0 in both concrete profiles. Passing a live Q<Bit>
to the ordinary Bit function remains an exact type error. The selected coherent
lift remains unsupported, independently of its ordinary-call support.

These four small sources, exact predictions and actual observations precede
production changes. Additional independent phase/reference, effect, shape,
arity and private-dependency controls belong in focused Rust tests. No full
repository inventories or build outputs are copied. All applicable QS/PR/RS/
EXACT duties remain; ordinary QLV1 ownership/scope admissions are unchanged.
